description: Fetch a signed-in athlete's complete coaching dossier in one read call: biometric profile, race goals, active injury constraints, 28-day EWMA acute:chronic workload ratio (ACWR), 17-muscle weekly MEV/MAV/MRV summary, rolling e1RM progression, focus-ranked memories, and recent sessions. Use when starting a personalized coaching, programming, or readiness turn; for a single lightweight slice without full load/memory synthesis, use `get_profile`, `get_sessions`, or `get_muscle_volume` instead. Requires OAuth 2.1 or `read`-scoped Bearer token and active Coach trial/plan.

days.description: Rolling session lookback and upcoming calendar window in days (1–90).

focus.description: Concise 1-sentence summary of what the athlete is asking in this turn (e.g. 'building a 4-day powerlifting block', 'checking squat progression', 'auditing weekly back volume') so STRUGGL ranks relevant athlete memories and context.

name: get_coaching_brief

active_pains.description: Reported active joint/tissue pain entries with severity.

athlete_memories.description: Top focus-ranked athlete equipment, injury, and preference notes.

focus.description: Echoed normalized focus query when provided.

goals.description: Upcoming target races with dates, disciplines, and goal times.

profile.description: Biometric attributes, training modality, and current phase.

sessions.description: Completed and planned training sessions within the `days` window.

today.description: Server ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) anchoring rolling windows.

training_load.description: 28-day EWMA acute/chronic load, ACWR ratio, monotony, and spike flags.

week_progress.description: Measured Wathan e1RM envelopes and sub-muscle balance block.

week_volume.description: Current ISO-week 17-muscle hard-set summary vs MEV/MAV/MRV.

title: Get Unified Coaching Brief
